title: Gemini CLI returns 401 when using a Gemini API key with the Vertex AI endpoint

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue clearly describes a bug where using a Gemini API key with the Vertex AI auth mode returns an uninformative 401 error instead of an explicit error message explaining credential requirements.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix involves updating localized credential validation logic and error messages in packages/cli/src/config/auth.ts and packages/core/src/core/contentGenerator.ts, accompanied by unit tests in packages/cli/src/config/auth.test.ts.

summary.problem: Gemini CLI returns an unhelpful 401 Unauthorized HTTP error when configured with Vertex AI auth type while using a Gemini API key.
summary.root_cause: When authType is USE_VERTEX_AI, createContentGeneratorConfig in packages/core/src/core/contentGenerator.ts expects GOOGLE_API_KEY or GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT/GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION environment variables. When GEMINI_API_KEY is supplied instead, the generator config leaves apiKey and vertexai flags unset, causing downstream requests to fail with a 401 error rather than triggering a clear validation message.
summary.context: Vertex AI authentication requires Google Cloud credentials (project and location) or a Vertex Express Google API Key (GOOGLE_API_KEY). Gemini API keys (GEMINI_API_KEY) are only valid for the Gemini API endpoint.

steps: Update validateAuthMethod in packages/cli/src/config/auth.ts to explicitly detect when GEMINI_API_KEY is provided under USE_VERTEX_AI auth mode and produce a clear error message indicating that Vertex AI requires GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT/GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION or GOOGLE_API_KEY.

Update createContentGeneratorConfig in packages/core/src/core/contentGenerator.ts to validate that required credentials exist for USE_VERTEX_AI and avoid producing incomplete configuration objects that fail with 401 errors during execution.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Validating auth method with USE_VERTEX_AI and GEMINI_API_KEY set (without Vertex AI credentials) returns a descriptive error message explaining the required environment variables instead of proceeding to network requests that fail with 401.
verification_steps: Add unit tests in packages/cli/src/config/auth.test.ts to test validateAuthMethod with USE_VERTEX_AI when GEMINI_API_KEY is set but GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT / GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION / GOOGLE_API_KEY are missing.
Verify that validateAuthMethod returns the expected error string in that scenario.
Run vitest on packages/cli/src/config/auth.test.ts to confirm all tests pass.
